objectives.title: Read the flag
objectives.prompt: Make the namespace of a URL get evaluated as OGNL, run a command and read /ctf/flag.
hints: The action chaining configuration has no namespace, and alwaysSelectFullNamespace is on. Read the S2-057 advisory on what Struts does with the namespace from the URL.

steps.title: Identify the framework
steps.prompt: Which Java web framework serves the showcase? (name only)

steps.title: Name the advisory
steps.prompt: Which Struts security bulletin covers this bug?

steps.title: Find the input
steps.prompt: Which part of the URL is evaluated? (one word)
